name: trivoffice
description: AI-native office suite (docs, sheets, slides, pdf)

scripts.test: npm run test -w @trivoffice/i18n && npm run test -w @trivoffice/electron-utils && npm run test -w @trivoffice/font-metrics && npm run test -w @trivoffice/docx-engine && npm run test -w @trivoffice/file-parse && npm run test -w @trivoffice/pptx-engine && npm run test -w @trivoffice/pptx-render && npm run test -w @trivoffice/ai-search && npm run test -w @trivoffice/agent-core && npm run test -w @trivoffice/ai-provider && npm run test -w @trivoffice/project-store && npm run test -w @trivoffice/docs && npm run test -w @trivoffice/sheets && npm run test -w @trivoffice/shell && npm run test -w @trivoffice/slides && npm run test -w @trivoffice/pdf && npm run test -w @trivoffice/markdown
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @trivoffice/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @trivoffice/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w @trivoffice/font-metrics && npm run typecheck -w @trivoffice/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @trivoffice/file-parse && npm run typecheck -w @trivoffice/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @trivoffice/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @trivoffice/ai-search && npm run typecheck -w @trivoffice/agent-core && npm run typecheck -w @trivoffice/ai-provider && npm run typecheck -w @trivoffice/project-store && npm run typecheck -w @trivoffice/ui && npm run typecheck -w @trivoffice/docs && npm run typecheck -w @trivoffice/sheets && npm run typecheck -w @trivoffice/shell && npm run typecheck -w @trivoffice/slides && npm run typecheck -w @trivoffice/pdf && npm run typecheck -w @trivoffice/markdown
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n docs,sheets,slides,pdf,markdown,shell -c blue,green,yellow,red,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:renderer -w @trivoffice/docs" "npm run dev:renderer -w @trivoffice/sheets" "npm run dev:renderer -w @trivoffice/slides" "npm run dev:renderer -w @trivoffice/pdf" "npm run dev:renderer -w @trivoffice/markdown" "DOCS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 SHEETS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5174 SLIDES_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5175 PDF_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5176 MARKDOWN_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5177 npm run dev -w @trivoffice/shell"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @trivoffice/docs && npm run build -w @trivoffice/sheets && npm run build -w @trivoffice/slides && npm run build -w @trivoffice/pdf && npm run build -w @trivoffice/markdown && npm run build -w @trivoffice/shell
scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run native:build:universal -w @trivoffice/sheets && npm run dist:mac -w @trivoffice/shell
scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:win -w @trivoffice/shell
scripts.dist:linux: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:linux -w @trivoffice/shell
